people.name: Assyria
people.line: A powerful ancient empire, often in conflict with Israel.

people.name: Damascus
people.line: Ancient city, capital of Syria, important in biblical history.

people.name: Kir
people.line: A city or region in Mesopotamia, possibly Elam

people.name: Rezin
people.line: King of Aram (Syria) during the reign of Ahaz

translations.web: The king of Assyria listened to him; and the king of Assyria went up against Damascus, and took it, and carried its people captive to Kir, and killed Rezin.
translations.bsb: So the king of Assyria responded to him, marched up to Damascus, and captured it. He took its people to Kir as captives and put Rezin to death.
translations.kjv: And the king of Assyria hearkened unto him: for the king of Assyria went up against Damascus, and took it, and carried the people of it captive to Kir, and slew Rezin.
translations.asv: And the king of Assyria hearkened unto him; and the king of Assyria went up against Damascus, and took it, and carried the people of it captive to Kir, and slew Rezin.
